headline: Executive order signed May 9, 2025, calls for creating a National Center for Warrior Independence focused on veterans.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order addresses commitments to US veterans and directs the creation of a new National Center for Warrior Independence. No summary was provided, so the details of what the center will do, where it will be, and how it will be paid for are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears aimed at veterans, likely through services offered by the new center, though the specific services are not described in the available material.
As the federal agency that serves veterans, it would likely be involved in setting up or running the new center, though the title does not say so directly.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 9, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available material.
